Seven different manufacturers – ten different winners on six brands (Audi, BMW, Mercedes, Lamborghini, Porsche and Ferrari) through twelve races are but one testament to the unique competitive balance that makes every DTM weekend a revelation! programme.title: Crvena zvezda vs Barcelona - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 MD4

Inter vs Arsenal - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 MD4
programme.desc: Internazionale and Arsenal only met previously in the 2003-04 UEFA Champions League – both games were away wins. Arsenal have failed to score in each of their last four away UEFA Champions League games in Italy, with Emmanuel Adebayor the last Gunners player to score there in a 2-0 win over Milan in March 2008.

programme.title: Bayern München vs Benfica - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 MD4
programme.desc: Bayern Munich have played 12 major European matches against Benfica and have never lost – it is the most one side has faced another without losing across all major European competitions. Benfica have lost all six of their away European games against Bayern Munich, conceding 24 goals at an average of four per game. Their last Munich visit saw them lose 5-2 in November 2021.

Manchester City’s current winless run against Juventus is their joint-longest against an opponent in European competition, along with a five-game run against Barcelona between 2014 and 2016. However, this will be the first time Man City have faced Juventus during Pep Guardiola’s reign.

programme.title: Borussia Dortmund vs Barcelona - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 MD6

Indeed, they conceded five to Real Madrid on MD3 this season, going on to lose by three goals in a game they had led 2-0 at half time.

programme.desc: Crvena Zvezda and PSV have met just twice before in European competition, with both of those coming in qualifying for the 2004-05 UEFA Champions League. After winning 3-2 at home in the first leg, Crvena Zvezda were eliminated in the third round, following a 0-5 defeat in the second leg on the road. This will be just the third time that teams from Serbia/Yugoslavia and the Netherlands have faced off in the European Cup/UEFA Champions League, with the previous two games coming back in the Last 16 of the 1956-57 European Cup - Crvena Zvezda won 6-3 on aggregate against Rapid JC Heerlen.

programme.desc: Liverpool and Lille’s only previous meetings in Europe came back in the 2009-10 UEFA Europa League, with the Reds progressing from the Last 16 with a 3-1 aggregate victory. Lille have only won one of their 10 games against English sides in the UEFA Champions League, losing each of the last six in a row. Their only victory against an English opponent in the competition was in November 2005, beating Manchester United 1-0 in a home game.

programme.title: Feyenoord vs Bayern München - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 MD7
programme.desc: Feyenoord and Bayern Munich’s only previous meetings in Europe came in this competition back in 2001-02, with the Dutch side failing to win either game in the UEFA Champions League first group stage that season. Bayern Munich are unbeaten in their last eight UEFA Champions League games against Dutch opponents, with their last such defeat coming away to PSV in October 1999. They have failed to win each of the most recent two, however, drawing twice against Ajax in the 2018-19 group stage.

As the tournament’s most prestigious stage, Centre Court continues to deliver the drama, precision, and elegance that define The Championships.

programme.title: Jannik Sinner (ITA) vs Carlos Alcaraz (ESP) - Gentlemen’s Singles Final - Centre Court - Wimbledon 2
programme.desc: Top seed Jannik Sinner takes on defending champion Carlos Alcaraz in a blockbuster Wimbledon final. This is their fifth career meeting, with Alcaraz leading the head-to-head 3–1. Sinner is chasing his first Wimbledon crown, while Alcaraz aims for a historic third straight title. A generational battle on Centre Court.

programme.title: Anna DANILINA (KAZ) Aleksandra KRUNIC (SRB) vs Sara ERRANI (ITA) Jasmine PAOLINI (ITA) - Women's Dou
programme.desc: Second seeds Sara Errani and Jasmine Paolini take on Anna Danilina and Aleksandra Krunić in the women's doubles final. Errani and Paolini, finalists for the second consecutive year, aim to secure their first Roland-Garros title as a team against the unseeded duo of Danilina and Krunić

programme.title: Arturo Coello ESP Agustín Tapia AUS vs Federico CHINGOTTO ARG Alejandro GALAN ESP - Men Final's - Pr
programme.desc: World No. 1 duo Arturo Coello & Agustín Tapia face World No. 2 Federico Chingotto & Alejandro Galán in a thrilling Málaga final. It’s the biggest rivalry of the 2025 season, with both pairs trading titles across the tour. Expect fast-paced rallies, tactical brilliance, and a fierce battle for Premier Padel supremacy.

programme.title: Manchester United vs Liverpool English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Manchester United have won just one of their last 12 Premier League meetings with Liverpool, beating them 2-1 at Old Trafford in their third game of the 2022-23 campaign. Liverpool have lost just one of their last six Premier League away games against Manchester United, while only Manchester City have won away at Old Trafford more often than the Reds in the competition’s history.

programme.title: Everton vs Liverpool - English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Everton won 2-0 in their last Premier League game against Liverpool in April 2024, last winning consecutive league Merseyside derbies in the 1984-85 campaign. Liverpool’s 2-0 loss in this exact fixture last season ended a 12-game unbeaten away run in the Premier League against Everton. They’ve not lost consecutive visits to Goodison Park since a run of three between 1992 and 1994.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Crystal Palace- English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Man City have lost just one of their last 12 Premier League games against Crystal Palace, going down 2-0 at home in October 2021. programme.title: FC Barcelona / Valence
programme.desc: Five days after ensuring its place in the 8th finals of the Champions League in a crazy match against Benfica (4-5), FC Barcelona, 3rd, must now straighten the bar in Liga to stay in the title race against Valence, 19th, which has found a smile since the arrival of Carlos Corberán. Guided by a Raphinha that is walking on the water this season with 22 goals and 11 assists in all competitions, a perfect Lamine Yamal in the creation of the game thanks to his magical left foot, a Robert Lewandowski, top scorer in Liga with 16 achievements, who found a second youth under the orders of Hansi Flick or a Jules Koundé with a great reading of the game, Catalans, deprived of Pedri, have all the cards in hand to put an end to their bad series of 4 games without victories and not to let Real Madrid fly to the top of the ranking against the Ché club which counts on the decisive parades of the future Liverpool goalkeeper, Giorgi Mamar ...

programme.title: Marseille / Lille
programme.desc: Having become unstoppable under the orders of Roberto de Zerbi with 6 victories in the last 7 games, Olympique de Marseille is in full confidence before approaching this shock of the 16th finals of the Coupe de France against the LOSC, unbeaten since September 17. Led by a Geronimo Rulli in the form of his life, the only guardian of the 5 major European championships to have stopped three penalties on three attempts, an Adrien Rabiot radiating in his new role as a second striker or a Mason Greenwood still as technically magic, elected best league 1 of December, the Phocaeans, ten times winners of the competition, have all the cards in hand Victories in an incandescent velodrome stadium against DOGUES, always deprived of Edon Zhegrova, which rely on the solidity of the Bafodé Diakité - Alexsandro, the cold gesture in the last gesture of the top scorer in Ligue 1, Jonathan David, and the immense experience of the captain, Benjami ...

programme.title: Bayer Leverkusen / Friborg
programme.desc: In roller mode compressor since the end of November with 7 consecutive victories all competitions, Bayer Leverkusen, 2nd, wants to continue on its momentum in this highly anticipated duel against SC Friborg, 8th, which still dreams of the Champions League at the end of the season. Led by a technically dazzling Florian Wirtz with 6 goals and 5 assists in the Bundesliga, a vital Xhaka granite in the game system of Xabi Alonso or a Jonathan Tah who has become a defensive Roc alongside Edmond Tapsoba and Piero Hincapie, the Pillenklub has all the cards in hand to conclude the year 2024 Bayern Munich in the title race against Brazilians from Brigsau who rely on the speed and technique of Ritsu Doan, precious recovery in the midfield of Maximilian Eggestein and the magic right foot of Vincenzo Grifo, 7 assists on the counter, to strike a big blow to the Bayarena and assert himself as a serious candidate for Europe.

programme.desc: CLAP FINDING IN APOTOTHEMENT AT THE EURO ESPERS 2025: Germany defies England in the final in Bratislava for electric revenge between two European football giants. Beaten by the Mannschaft in the group phase (2-1), the Young Lions of Lee Carsley have since raised the cursor. Brilliant against Spain (1-3) in quarters, then solid against the Netherlands (2-1), they arrived launched, carried by a sparkling Harvey Elliott: 3 goals and 1 decisive pass in the matches with direct elimination. But Germany impresses even more. Intouchables in hens (9 points), Antonio Di Salvo's men first snatched their place in half against Italy (3-2 A.P.), before offset France (3-0). With 14 goals scored in 5 games, their attack is formidable, led by Nick Woltemade, top scorer of the tournament (6 goals). Between a revengeful England and a Germany in full control, this final promises intensity, talent and fireworks.

programme.title: Stuttgart / Bavaria Munich
programme.desc: Five days before receiving the Bayer Leverkusen in the 8th round of the Champions League, Bayern Munich has an opportunity to take a new step towards the title of Germany champion on the lawn of the VFB Stuttgart, 7th, under large pressure in the race for European places. Worn by a Harry Kane widely at the top of the Bundesliga scorers' ranking with 21 achievements this season, a Jamal Musiala still as confusing ball or a Michael Olise well installed in the right corridor with 7 goals and 7 assists on the clock, the Bavarians have all the cards in hand to win the MHP Arena and increase their lead Form of Nick Woltemade, 8 goals this season, the technical quality of Enzo Millot and the decisive parades of the former Monegasque porter, Alexander Nübel, to win precious points at home and put pressure on their competitors in the race for Europe.

programme.title: Villarreal / Real Madrid
programme.desc: Less than 72 hours after its qualification for the quarterfinals of the Champions League, Real Madrid (2nd) must quickly get back into the Liga bath with a complicated trip to Villarreal (5th), still well placed in the C1 race. The Merengues are counting on a revanchard vinicius after its missed penalty against Atlético de Madrid, ready to prove its value. Aurélien Tchouameni, who has become essential in the midfield, plays a key role in the structure of Carlo Ancelotti's game. Finally, Kylian Mbappé, in search of his 30th goal under the Madrid colors, is more motivated than ever to extend his series. With these assets, Real hopes to start from the Estadio de la Cerámica with the three points and temporarily take the head of the Liga. For his part, Villarreal is betting on the experience of Dani Parejo to orchestrate the game in the middle, while the former Newcastle player, Ayoze Pérez, author of 11 goals this season, and the magic winger Nicolas Pépé, will be offensive weapons ...

programme.title: Portugal / France
programme.desc: The 2025 Euro Espoirs opens with a summit. In search of a title that has been fleeing them since 1988, Gérald Batic's blueberries are starting their campaign against Portugal, one of the big favorites in the tournament. Despite Hugo Ekitike's major absences, Arnaud Kalimuendo or Maghnes Akliouche, the tricolor attack looks great with Mathys Tel, Mathis Abline, Wilson Odobert and Thierno Barry who offer a varied and explosive offensive palette. Behind them, the duo Diouf - the lens regulates the tempo with accuracy, while Guillaume remains assures with authority in the hot moments. An eleven young but formidably structured, determined to mark its entry territory. Portugal is advancing the bombed chest. Boosted by the blossoming of the Geovany Quenda phenomenon, a new jewel of Chelsea, the Seleção also relies on the finesse of Mateus Fernandes and the solidity of Samuel Soares in the cages to win. This shock in Trencin promises to be a full -scale test for the two nations.
